note: remote store; skills registered with the host, ownership-scoped; three upstream fixes ported from 2.31.1-2.31.3; BM25 lexical channel and rank fusion (OPENCODE_MEM_RRF=1), lexical ranking and the fusion itself computed globally over all shards, tokenized corpus cached; query text carried into the shard search; MCP over HTTP on POST /mcp; tier-aware aging sweep (POST /api/sweep) with a reversible tombstone, thresholds 90 and 365 days, the profile items whose support was forgotten go with it; capture summary: the internal session is created the way the free tier accepts it and falls back to a session message; shadow index for a second embedding model (POST /api/reindex); per-client keys with a scope; a profile identity can be moved to another machine (POST /api/user-profile/transfer); soft deduplication (POST /api/deduplicate/mark); compaction of the marked duplicates (POST /api/compact); contradiction flags (POST /api/conflicts/scan), a value conflict only on short claims; usage statistics with the store memory (GET /api/stats) and the web view
